actors:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art game character sprite sheet, PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
Primary request: original gothic animal-adventure fighters, inspired by the authentic chunky Game Boy Color visual vocabulary of Mina the Hollower, without copying its exact characters, assets, or logo.
Canvas: requested 1024 x 1536 pixels, portrait, exactly 3 columns x 4 rows of separate poses. All 12 cells equal size with generous completely transparent blank gutters. No rendered grid or labels.
Style: truly low-resolution game sprites, each body about 40 x 48 logical pixels, enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor square pixels. Deliberately large square pixel clusters and 1-logical-pixel black outlines. Simple small expressive animal silhouettes, limited flat palette: cream/bone, bright azure blue, crimson, teal, muted copper, slate and violet. Only a few flat shade colors.
Hero: one consistent original ivory-furred big-eared mouse explorer, azure cropped coat, copper goggles resting on forehead, slate satchel. A long CRIMSON RAPIER in right hand and small teal buckler in left hand. Every hero pose faces RIGHT, opponent is to its right.
Rival: one consistent original hunched raven cemetery sentinel in burgundy coat and teal-gray beaked half-mask, small broad-brim hat, holding a long hooked pick made of bone and copper. Every rival pose faces LEFT, opponent is to its left.
Exact cell order from left to right:
Row 1: hero idle; hero attack windup with crimson rapier drawn back; hero strike lunging crimson rapier toward RIGHT.
Row 2: hero guard with teal buckler raised toward RIGHT; hero hurt recoiling; hero death lying on its side.
Row 3: rival idle; rival attack windup with hooked pick drawn back; rival strike swinging hooked pick toward LEFT.
Row 4: rival guard; rival hurt recoiling; rival death lying on its side.
Composition: same character body scale in all poses. Standing feet at 90% of each cell's height. Death poses rest at the same ground baseline. Complete weapons, mouse tail, ears and all limbs stay inside their own cell and do not touch other silhouettes. Center each character body horizontally within its cell; generously accommodate the longer horizontal strike weapons with blank gutter separation.
Background: fully transparent everywhere outside each silhouette, including gutters. No floor, no ground shadows, no background color, no labels, no border, no text, no watermark.
Avoid: painterly rendering, 3D, realistic materials, modern detailed pixel art, gradients, halos, glow, blur, soft edges, tiny high-frequency detail, anti-aliased contour.
arena:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background for a side-view fighting game, one opaque PNG.
Primary request: original gothic cobblestone courtyard after dark in an authentic chunky Game Boy Color animal-adventure visual style, in the spirit of Mina the Hollower screenshots without reproducing exact game assets or logo.
Canvas: wide 16:9 landscape.
Scene: teal-gray steep slate roofs and stairways clustered on the far left and far right, muted copper-lit small windows, distant crooked wrought-iron gate, a tiny moon in heavy black sky, deep indigo shadows, sparse muted brick-red ivy. A broad level cobblestone ground band suitable for side-view fighting extends across the lower portion of the image.
Composition: keep the center 65% and foreground EMPTY, simple and low contrast so bright small character sprites will read clearly. Architecture and environmental detail richer at far sides. Ground must offer a flat broad fight area without obstacles or characters, maintain clear ground band.
Style: authentic low-resolution Game Boy Color pixel scene enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor large square pixel clusters; limited flat palette, 1-logical-pixel black contour language, simplified shapes, no continuous shading. Deliberately chunky, modest sprite-era detail.
Color palette: black sky, indigo shadows, teal-gray slate, muted copper, sparse muted brick-red accents. Background low contrast and dark.
Constraints: no characters, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no foreground obstruction.
Avoid: painterly rendering, 3D, realistic textures, intricate modern high-detail pixel art, gradients, halo, glow, bloom, soft edges or anti-aliasing.
icons:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production item icon sprite sheet, PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
Primary request: twelve original gothic animal-adventure item icons in authentic chunky Game Boy Color pixel style, in the spirit of Mina the Hollower, without exact game assets or logo.
Canvas: requested 1024 x 768 pixels, landscape, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows, equal-sized cells.
Exact order left to right:
Row 1: long crimson rapier; sapphire-blue shield; purple alchemist spark-flask; gold focus talisman.
Row 2: green poison vial; black bomb with ivory rim and amber fuse; red heart; copper coin.
Row 3: red potion; mint amulet; ivory crown; ivory four-point star.
Style: each icon uses about 16 x 16 logical pixels enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor square pixel clusters. Two to four flat colors per icon with a 1-logical-pixel black edge. Cream/bone highlights, crimson, sapphire blue, purple, gold, green, amber, copper, mint. Deliberately chunky silhouettes, simple and readable at tiny scale.
Composition: each icon centered in its own cell. Generous 25% completely blank transparent cell gutters on all sides. All icon details including rapier tip, bomb fuse, and star points remain inside their cell; no silhouettes touch.
Background: fully transparent everywhere outside the icons. Preserve genuine alpha. No colored backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Constraints: exactly 12 separate icons, no text, no numbers, no cell border, no grid, no logos, no watermark, no shadows.
Avoid: gradients, glow, halos, blurred or soft edges, painterly or 3D rendering, high-detail modern pixel illustration, anti-aliasing.
